study_identification_part.si_4_title: Normative modelling of brain function abnormalities in complex pathology needs the whole brain

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: The primary method is Functional Connectivity Integrative Normative Modelling (FUNCOIN), which uses covariate-assisted principal regression for simultaneous dimensionality reduction and log-linear regression of FC matrices. This is compared against a localized, edgewise normative model using ordinary least squares regression (OLSR) on Fisher z-transformed correlations.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: we thus propose Functional Connectivity Integrative Normative Modelling (FUNCOIN) as a novel whole-brain approach to normative modelling of FC. ... we contrasted FUNCOIN to an edgewise approach, where multiple models predict each connection in the FC matrix independently. ... we predicted the Fisher z-transformed correlations values by for each edge fitting a linear regression model.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.location: Kobbersmed2025.pdf.md: Abstract; Results / Localized normative models cannot reliably find deviances in FC

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Resting-state functional connectivity (FC) represented as Pearson correlation matrices (for FUNCOIN) or Fisher z-transformed correlation values (for the edgewise model) derived from 55 ICA components.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: Our measure of brain function is FC, determined in this case as the Pearson correlation matrix from all pairs of the parcellation components (Fig. 1A, bottom). ... we predicted the Fisher z-transformed correlations values
nm2_2_response_variable.location: Kobbersmed2025.pdf.md: Results / Whole-brain normative modelling of FC; Results / Localized normative models cannot reliably find deviances in FC

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Both models included biological sex, age (linearly transformed), and the interaction between sex and age.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: We included sex, age, and sex-age interaction as covariates. ... fitting a linear regression model with sex, age, and sex-age interaction as covariates.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.location: Kobbersmed2025.pdf.md: Materials and methods / Model fitting; Results / Localized normative models cannot reliably find deviances in FC
